message.content: It sounds like you’re describing Boston’s summer heat, but the temperature figure isn’t quite right. Boston’s record high temperature is about **54 °F (≈12 °C)**, not 54 °C. In recent years, average highs in July and August tend to hover around **80–85 °F (27–29 °C)**, with occasional spikes into the low 90s (≈32–35 °C). So while it can feel hot, especially on humid days, Boston doesn’t actually reach 54 °C—those temperatures are more typical of places like Phoenix or Riyadh.
